sources.routeFilter: Filter by route_id 78 (Pacific Surfliner). All other route_ids in this feed are long-distance Amtrak (out-reservation). Do not pass any other route_id to the board.
knownRisks: No Amtrak SLA or service continuity guarantee for the Track-A-Train endpoint.
Transitdocs is volunteer-maintained; no continuity guarantee.
Track-A-Train data is sometimes stale or day-old; derived GTFS-RT inherits this quality issue.
Amtrak web terms prohibit redistribution without prior written permission. Tim's approval is the operative gate.
sources.note: Transitdocs asks to be notified (asm-contact@transitdocs.com) as a courtesy when their feed is used — not a formal attribution clause. Record in provider comments.

notes: Second operator on the existing Los Angeles catalog. No new stations added. Only the single in-catalog station where Pacific Surfliner calls is included: Union Station (GTFS stop_id 'LAX', GTFS stop_name 'Los Angeles', catalog name 'Union Station').
Pomona North is NOT a Pacific Surfliner station. Pacific Surfliner (route 78) does not run into the San Gabriel Valley. Do not add Pomona North.

Pacific Surfliner direction group is separate from LA Metro Rail direction group AND Metrolink direction group on the same Union Station board. Three operator groups coexist; directions must not be collapsed across groups.
7th St/Metro Ctr is the Metro Rail hub lock (A × B × D × E). Never a Pacific Surfliner direction token. Pacific Surfliner does not call at 7th St/Metro Ctr.
A trip terminating at the board station is not a direction chip there. 13 trips whose final stop is 'Los Angeles' (stop_id LAX) terminate at Union Station and are not chips at Union Station.

Long-distance Amtrak trains in the same transitdocs feed (Coast Starlight, Southwest Chief, Sunset Limited, Texas Eagle, and all other route_ids) are out-reservation. Filter by route_id 78 only. No other Amtrak route appears on this board.
Chip text format: 'Pacific Surfliner + {exact GTFS final stop_name}'. No route_short_name prefix variant — the prefix is always 'Pacific Surfliner'.
Timezone America/Los_Angeles HAS DST (PDT/PST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.
City id: los-angeles (same as the Metro Rail pack). This is the Pacific Surfliner second-operator supplement. Do not overwrite docs/los-angeles-d1/published-network.json.
Tim approved feed wiring on 25 Oct 2026. Status stays 'planned' until Jim writes the provider code. Feed approval does not change Jim's job — do not write provider code in lib/.
